abstract.p: A compound comprising a ligand L<sub>A</sub> comprising a moiety L having a structure of Formula Iis provided. In Formula I, L<sub>A</sub> coordinated to a metal M; A<sup>1</sup> is selected from B, N, P, P=O, P=S, Al, Ga, SiR", GeR", and SnR"; where rings A, B, and C are 5- or 6-membered rings; Y<sup>1</sup>, Y<sup>2</sup>, and Y<sup>3</sup> are selected from direct bonds, the metal M, and a variety of linkers; a + b + c = 2 or 3; and one of a number of specific conditions is met. OLED devices, consumer products, and formulations including the compound are also provided.
